Then 1-m_j=sQ_j(s) for strictly decreasing cubic Q_j (Q_j'<=1/3-2c<0); unique roots yield exact finite second-moment stability intervals and s_B<s_S for K>=3. Since m_B>m_S and n_B>=n_S, 1/lambda<V_S<V_B over their shared stable interval. K=2 agrees in law. Verified exact moment algebra by independent rational enumeration of all Bernoulli patterns K=2..8.
